fidelity: F2a — Full Electrochemical Model with Thermal ODE
description: Gas-diffusion-electrode CO2 reduction cell. Cathodic CO2RR to CO competes with parasitic H2 evolution; anodic OER. Cell voltage = E_rev + cathode/anode Tafel + ohmic + concentration overpotentials. Driven cell (V > E_rev). FE_CO peaks ~0.90 and rolls off toward H2 as j approaches the CO2 mass-transport limit.
source: Endrodi et al. (2017) Prog. Energy Combust. Sci.; Burdyny & Smith (2019) Energy Environ. Sci.; Weng et al. (2018) PCCP; Jouny et al. (2018) Ind. Eng. Chem. Res.

unit.name: Generic CO2RR-to-CO MEA Stack — Physics-Lumped Electrochemical

N_cells.note: Number of cells in series in the stack

A_cell.note: Active geometric electrode area (lab/pilot GDE cell)

n_electrons.note: Electrons per CO2 reduced to CO (2 e- per molecule)

E_rev.note: Reversible cell voltage for CO2->CO + 1/2 O2 (E_anode 1.23 - E_cathode -0.11 vs SHE)

E_tn.note: Thermoneutral voltage (E_rev + T*dS term); above this the cell self-heats

j0_cathode_ref.note: CO2RR exchange current density at T_ref (Ag/Au-type catalyst)

j0_anode_ref.note: OER exchange current density at T_ref (IrO2/NiFe-type catalyst)

j_L.note: CO2 mass-transport limiting current density at the GDE

FE_max.note: Peak Faradaic efficiency toward CO at low/moderate j

FE_rolloff_k.note: Logistic steepness of FE_CO roll-off vs (j/j_L)

FE_rolloff_x0.note: Logistic midpoint (j/j_L) where FE_CO has dropped to FE_max/2
